text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
When I saw the winner's face, I was
really struck
by how radiant she looked
in her moment of
victory...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I love seeing everyone's smiles,
but... it's 
disappointing only being able to see
them
without getting to smile myself...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
choice_data_list: Next time, I won't just be watching.
Let's give it our all so we can smile!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
choice_data_list: Once we get some food in us, let's...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to work real hard after my
stomach's
nice and full!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, okay. You're right. I'm going to do

everything I can so we can smile too
next time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Okay, no more moping! Here's to getting
even
stronger!
